title: 序章传奇落幕第1章 新的旅程
content_zh:
序章 传奇落幕
乌云笼罩着天空，昏暗无光的地面上到处都是一片狼籍。盘旋而上的阶梯，血迹斑斑的尸体，盔甲，武器，一切的一切都是这么的混乱，荒凉，带着死亡和危险的味道。
罗德吸了口气，但是他并没有能够感受到空气中的冰冷与血腥，这毕竟只是个游戏。想到这里，罗德苦笑着摇了摇头，随后，他转过身去，望着身下不远处那些正盘坐在地面上的战友，此刻他们正在安静的休息，恢复自己的力量，修理着自己的武器。表面上看起来与平日没有任何不同，但是罗德却很清楚，这一战，并不象之前那么容易。
“有多少人留了下来。”
他沉声问道。
听到这个问题，众人们互相望了一眼，随后，一个骨瘦如柴的法师站了起来。
“九十六个，团长，虚空之龙这副本比我们想象的还要危险，好多兄弟都挂在之前的陷阱上了，唯一幸运的是，现在我们的职业还算齐整。”
“这样就好。”
听到这里，罗德点了点头，没有再说什么，而其他的人则同样沉默了下去。
如果是换了普通的团队，恐怕这个时候早已经丧失了胆气开始混乱，毕竟他们即将要面对的，是游戏之中最强大，最可怕，从未被任何人所征服的精英BOSS，虚空之龙，网络游戏龙魂大陆第三篇章的最终BOSS，也是直到目前为止，最可怕的存在。面对这样的战斗，普通的公会至少要组织十个团才敢前来试着挑战，而现在，罗德的手下只有九十六人，甚至连一个完整的团都凑不齐，但是即便如此，这些人的眼中，却没有出现丝毫的慌乱与失措，有的只是镇定，自信以及信赖。
而让他们如此信赖的人，此刻正站在他们面前不远处的阶梯之上，抬头仰望着天空，坚毅如顽石的面孔上，一道冰冷的疤痕从眉宇划下，给人一种震慑人心的感觉。闪耀着魔法光华的盔甲覆盖在那威武雄壮的身体上，仿佛一堵永远不会倒塌的城墙。
当然，他们并不是因为这种外观上表露出来的威严而信赖眼前的男人，无论展现的如何强悍，那毕竟都只是游戏的人物设计，眉宇上的那道疤痕也没有什么可以用来诉说惨痛过去的回忆，单单只是游戏设定面部容貌时的配件而已。
真正具有威慑力的，是这个男人身后的那数不清的光环与成就。
第一个到达顶级的职业玩家。
第一个使用公认最为困难的职业召唤剑士走向颠峰的玩家。
自从龙魂大陆第一篇章“黑暗降临”开启以来，率领公会，依靠自己的能力，以及对全职业熟悉到精通的可怕程度，横扫了整整三个资料季度，拿下了所有BOSS首杀的领导者。每一次副本视频都会被无数玩家转载，奉为教学圣典般的存在，龙魂大陆之中第一玩家公会的会长———罗德。
他曾经亲手消灭了“黑暗降临”，开启了“动荡年代”，又再一次征服了“动荡年代”，来到了“虚空审判”。而现在，他将再一次用自己的双手，结束这“虚空审判”，但是，新的时代，却不再是由自己来开启了。
已经几年了？
罗德将目光从远处闪耀着雷霆之蛇的云海中收回，在内心自问。
自从妹妹病逝之后，进入龙魂大陆已经有整整七年了，在这七年里，为了强迫自己忘却那曾经痛苦的往事，他一次次自虐般的给自己设定着几乎遥不可及的目标，然后又一次次的达成，也只有那个时候带来的巨大的兴奋与荣耀，才会冲淡自己内心深处残留的伤痛。

但是，也只能够到此为止。
在一个月之前，罗德的父母出差国外，遭遇飓风导致飞机失事而身亡，罗德已经记不清当初自己接到电话，听到这个消息时是什么样的心情，但是现在，他已经做出了决定。离开这个游戏，重新回到现实的生活中去，这不仅仅是为了自己的父母，罗德也很清楚，自己已经到了必须要做出改变的时候了。
“会，会长？”
一个胆怯的声音响起，打断了罗德的回忆，他抬眼望去，只见人群中一个女法师怯生生的举起手来，双眼闪亮着注视着自己。
“你，你真的要离开了吗？”
“是的。”
罗德点了点头，随后收拾起了自己内心的复杂情感，他摇了摇头，重新注视着跟随在自己身边的这些同伴，这都是他七年来的回忆与收获，一起奋斗的七年时间内所收获的朋友。但是现在，他终将离他们而去，虽然在游戏之中，哪怕是只凭借一个手势，也可以熟悉到对方想要干什么的程度。但是当取下游戏头盔，回到现实之后，恐怕就再也无法认出对方了吧。
“我的求职简历昨天就发出去了，希望能够找到一家肯收我的公司吧。”
“如果我收到会长你的简历，我会直接安排你去当部门经理的，放心吧！”
一个骑士挥舞着手中的大剑，他的话也带动了原本有些沉闷的气氛，众人都是哈哈一笑。
“多谢你的好意，可惜我没有在简历里写这些，要知道我们公会敌人众多，万一被其他公会的人收到，那我的日子可就不好过了。”
罗德也是笑了笑开口回答，随后，他咳嗽了一声，变的严肃了起来。
“我想大家都知道，我们这些年是怎么过来的。”
听到这里，刚才还在笑的众人都闭上了嘴巴，安静的开始聆听他的说话。
“我们也知道，在论坛上，在网络上，有很多人指责我们，他们说我们破坏了游戏的平衡性，垄断了所有的BOSS首杀，让竞争失去了意义………坦白说，这些我认为都没有错，但是……”
说到这里，罗德猛然握住拳头，用力一挥。
“但是，这关我们什么事！我们是最强的公会，我们是最强的团队！我们有这个实力！那么我们就要去做，去抢！其他的公会实力不够，败下阵来那是他们自己的问题，如果他们的实力够强，那么他们大可以打破我们的垄断，我们对BOSS首杀的垄断不是靠规则，不是靠地位，不是靠对游戏公司的吹捧得来的，是我们靠自己的力量获取的！我们从不放弃，我们从不认输，我们也从不懈怠，所以我们才拥有现在的成绩和一切，这是我们应得的，就是这么简单。”
罗德停顿了下，这才继续说了下去。
“我爱这个公会，我也很怀念和大家一起度过的这七年，但是天下没有不散的宴席，我也该去寻找属于我的生活。但是，我永远不会忘记大家，也不会忘记公会，这里承载了我最痛苦的回忆，也有最高兴的回忆，我会在这里一直记着它。”
说着，罗德指了指自己的脑袋。

“很多人说这个公会离了我就玩不转了，我想现在已经有不少公会知道了这个消息，他们估计就在打算等我离开之后，磨刀霍霍等着把公会赶下来，打破我们的记录，但是这也太小看我们了。龙魂可不是一个只有我一个人的游戏，我一个人没有办法建立公会，我一个人也没有办法组织团队，更不可能去干掉BOSS拿首杀。所以我希望我走了之后，你们能够让那些打着鬼主意的家伙好好看看，这个公会为什么会如此强大，我们星光之所以能够占据龙魂大陆公会排行第一的真正实力！”
“是！”
“没有问题，会长！”
“交给我们吧，到那个时候我们会给那群白痴一个完美的答复！”
“很好。”
听到众人的回答，罗德点了点头，随后他转向人群的右侧。
“老刘。”
听到罗德的招呼，高瘦法师走出人群，来到他的身边，罗德注视着眼前的法师，沉默片刻，随后伸手摘下了自己胸口的徽章，放在了他的手中。
[系统公告：公会会长职务转移，团长职务转移]
“接下来的时代，是你们的时代了。”
罗德放开了手，他的声音非常平静，没有丝毫改变。
“所以，这场战斗交给你来指挥。”
“好，没有问题，罗德。”
法师点了点头，但是很快，他又重新开口说道。
“那么，作为公会会长，作为团长，我命令你来带领团队。”
“老刘？”
听到这个回答，罗德不由诧异的皱了下眉头。而这时，面对他的高瘦法师却是轻轻一笑，随后拍了拍罗德的肩膀。
“这个时代是你开启的，有始有终，罗德，这才是为人之道。”
“………”
听到这句话，罗德沉默了，他抬起头，望向身前不远处的同伴，此刻他们已经准备就绪，正在一如既往的等待着自己的命令。罗德握紧了剑，接着转过身，面向眼前不远处的高台，在那里，雷霆肆虐，轰鸣着闪现出明亮的光彩。

随后，罗德举起长剑，指向前方，他曾经有一个最平凡不过的开始，那么，就来一个最平凡不过的结束吧。
“开怪！！”
虚空之龙果然强悍无比。
罗德曾经与龙魂大陆中的几乎所有排的上号的BOSS交手过，甚至包括在设定之中的其他龙魂存在，但是没有一个比眼前的虚空之龙更加棘手，它的攻击模式更加复杂，几乎没有规律，它的伤害比起普通BOSS要高出好几倍，不用说速度，反应，乃至在防御方面，都有着超一流的水准。
这的确是个难以征服的对手。
罗德手握长剑，咬紧牙关注视着眼前的庞然大物，战斗已经到达了最后关头，而他是唯一的幸存者，但是即便如此，罗德的血量也已经所剩无己，刺眼的红色提醒着他，自己的生命力已经到达了极限。
虚空之龙又何尝不是如此呢？
望着对方那双血红色的，充满了怒意的龙眼，罗德忽然有一种很古怪的感觉，他仿佛可以体会到虚空之龙的心情——作为游戏中最强大，从未被人征服过的BOSS，现在居然落了这么个快要倒地的下场，它一定心里不好受吧。
那么，就让我陪你一起走好了。
想到这里，罗德举起左手。
伴随着一声清脆的鸣叫，罗德的剑上骤然暴发出了一道道燃烧的火焰，它们盘旋着化为了一只飞翔的火鸟，昂首朝天，冲向眼前的虚空之龙，而面对这迎面而来的攻击，虚空之龙也是发出了一声怒吼，接着高高的举起前爪，猛然扑下。
“！！！”
罗德感到自己的身体猛然一震，强大的力量迎面冲来，火烈鸟在悲鸣一声之后便立刻魂飞魄散，但是在它消失之前强烈的爆炸也让虚空之龙原本挥下的利爪未尽全功，而是被硬生生的震开。
一时间，空门大开。
罗德咬住牙关，眼前的鲜红越发耀眼，提示着他所受到的伤害已经到达了临界点，但是现在这已经不在他的考虑范围之内，这是最后的机会，要么成功，要么团灭。他举起手中的长剑，直刺向前，但是这时的虚空之龙却也已经缓过了劲，它咆哮一声，随后再次用力向下挥出利爪，而与此同时，罗德也扔出了自己手中的长剑。
雷霆一击，启动。
长剑化为耀眼的光辉直射巨龙的胸口，罗德专心致志的注视着它，看着那夹杂雷电的光辉从虚空之龙的利爪间隙中钻出，随后轻而易举的撕裂了巨龙身上的鳞片。
“———！！！”
震耳欲聋的龙吼声平地暴起，接着，巨大的龙爪重重拍在了罗德的身上。
眼前的鲜红几乎笼罩了整个世界，罗德已经再也看不清楚眼前的景象，但是从角落中浮现的系统提示，还是一如既往的清晰。

[恭喜星光公会夺得虚空之龙的首杀，一个永恒的邪恶被消灭了]
[人物受到过量伤害，即将死亡]
终于结束了。
注视着这行系统提示，罗德露出了一丝欣慰的笑意。
而就在这时，忽然一道明亮的光柱从天而降，笼罩在高台之上。
纯白的光芒在那瞬间照亮了原本阴暗的天空，驱散了原本挥之不去的阴云。
而就在这时，正在从墓地复活，向着高台赶去的其他人却是忽然停下了脚步，而那原本因为星光公会再一次取得首杀记录而闹的沸沸洋洋的世界频道，此刻也猛然间安静了下来。
一时间在那上面，只有一条信息残留，那是一条系统公告。
[系统公告：玩家罗德已经下线]
一个统治了整整三个游戏时代的传奇，就这样落幕了。
content_en:
Prologue The Legend Ends
Dark clouds covered the sky, and the dark ground was full of messes. The spiraling stairs, blood-stained corpses, armor, weapons, everything is so chaotic, desolate, and smells of death and danger.
Rhodes took a breath, but he couldn't feel the coldness and blood in the air. This was just a game after all. Thinking of this, Rhodes smiled bitterly and shook his head. Then, he turned around and looked at his comrades sitting cross-legged on the ground not far away. They were resting quietly, recovering their strength and repairing their weapons. On the surface, it looked no different from usual, but Rhodes knew very well that this battle was not as easy as before.
"How many people stayed."
he asked in a deep voice.
After hearing this question, everyone looked at each other, and then a skinny mage stood up.
"Ninety-six, Captain, this copy of Dragon of the Void is more dangerous than we thought. Many brothers have fallen into the previous traps. The only good thing is that our professions are relatively neat now."
"That's good."
Hearing this, Rhodes nodded and said nothing more, while the others also fell silent.
If they had replaced an ordinary team, I am afraid that they would have lost their courage and started to be confused by this time. After all, what they were about to face was the most powerful and terrifying elite BOSS in the game that had never been conquered by anyone. The Dragon of the Void was the final BOSS of the third chapter of the online game Dragon Soul Continent, and the most terrifying existence so far. Faced with such a battle, an ordinary guild would have to organize at least ten regiments before they would dare to challenge. Now, Rhodes has only ninety-six men, not even a complete regiment. But even so, there is no trace of panic or confusion in the eyes of these people, but only calmness, confidence and trust.
And the person they trusted so much was standing on the stairs not far in front of them, looking up at the sky. On his face as resolute as stone, a cold scar was drawn from his eyebrows, giving people a shocking feeling. The armor shining with magical brilliance covered that mighty and majestic body, like a wall that would never collapse.
Of course, they don't trust the man in front of them because of the majesty shown in this appearance. No matter how tough he appears, it is just the character design of the game. The scar on the eyebrow has nothing to tell the memories of the painful past. It is just an accessory for the game to set the facial appearance.
What is truly intimidating is the countless aura and achievements behind this man.
The first professional player to reach the top.
The first player to use the most difficult profession known as the Summoning Swordsman to reach the top.
Since the opening of the first chapter of Dragon Soul Continent, "Darkness Comes", he has led the guild, relying on his own abilities and his terrifying familiarity with all professions, to sweep through three data quarters and win the first kill of all BOSSes. Every copy video will be reposted by countless players and regarded as a teaching holy book. Rhodes is the president of the number one player guild in the Dragon Soul Continent.
He once personally eliminated the "Darkness Coming" and ushered in the "Troubleful Era". He once again conquered the "Troubled Era" and came to the "Judgment of the Void". Now, he will once again use his own hands to end this "Judgment of the Void", but the new era will no longer be opened by himself.
How many years has it been?
Rhodes withdrew his gaze from the sea of ​​clouds where the Thunder Snake shone in the distance, and asked himself in his heart.
It has been seven years since his sister died of illness. During these seven years, in order to force himself to forget the painful past, he onceHe sets almost unattainable goals for himself like masochistically, and then achieves them again and again. Only the great excitement and glory brought by that time will dilute the pain that remains deep in his heart.
However, it can only go so far.
A month ago, Rhode's parents were on a business trip abroad and died in a plane crash caused by a hurricane. Rhode couldn't remember how he felt when he received the call and heard the news, but now, he has made a decision. Leaving this game and returning to real life was not only for his parents, but Rhodes also knew that it was time for him to make changes.
"Yes, President?"
A timid voice sounded, interrupting Rhodes' memory. He looked up and saw a female mage in the crowd raising her hands timidly, staring at him with shining eyes.
"Are you really leaving?"
"Yes."
Rhodes nodded, and then put away the complicated emotions in his heart. He shook his head and looked at the companions following him again. These are his memories and gains in the past seven years, and the friends he has gained during the seven years of fighting together. But now, he will eventually leave them. Although in the game, even with just one gesture, you can become familiar with what the other party wants to do. But when you take off the gaming helmet and return to reality, you may no longer be able to recognize each other.
"I sent out my resume yesterday. I hope I can find a company willing to accept me."
"If I receive your resume, President, I will directly arrange for you to be the department manager. Don't worry!"
A knight waved the big sword in his hand, and his words also stirred up the originally dull atmosphere, and everyone laughed.
"Thank you for your kindness. It's a pity that I didn't write this in my resume. You know, our guild has many enemies. If someone from other guilds receives it, my life will be difficult."
Rhodes also smiled and answered, then he coughed and became serious.
"I think everyone knows how we've gotten here over the years."
After hearing this, everyone who had been laughing just now closed their mouths and began to listen quietly to what he said.
"We also know that there are many people criticizing us on forums and on the Internet. They say that we have destroyed the balance of the game, monopolized all BOSS first kills, and made competition meaningless... Frankly speaking, I think these are not wrong, but..."
Having said this, Rhodes suddenly clenched his fist and waved it hard.
"But, it's none of our business! We are the strongest guild, we are the strongest team! We have this strength! Then we have to do it and grab it! Other guilds are not strong enough. If they lose, it is their own problem. If they are strong enough, then they can break our monopoly, and we will The monopoly of BOSS's first kill is not obtained by rules, status, or praise of game companies. It is obtained by our own strength! We never give up, we never admit defeat, and we never slack off. That's why we have the results and everything we have now. This is what we deserve, it's that simple."
Rhodes paused for a moment before continuing.
"I love this guild, and I also miss the seven years I spent with you all, but there is no such thing as a banquet that lasts forever, and I should also look for a life that belongs to me. However, I will never forget you, nor will I forget the guild. This place carries my most painful memories, as well as my happiest memories, and I will always remember it here."
With that said, Rhodes pointed at his head.
"Many people say that this guild will never be able to function without me. I think many guilds have learned about this news now. They estimate thatThe plan is to wait for me to leave, sharpen the knife and wait to drive the guild down and break our record, but this is too underestimated of us. Dragon Soul is not a game for just me. I can’t build a guild by myself, I can’t organize a team by myself, and I can’t even kill the BOSS and get the first kill. So I hope that after I leave, you can let those people with evil intentions take a closer look at why this guild is so powerful, and the true strength of why our Starlight can occupy the first place among the guilds in Dragon Soul Continent! "
"yes! "
"No problem, President! "
"Leave it to us, we will give those idiots a perfect answer by then! "
"very good. "
After hearing everyone's answers, Rhodes nodded, and then he turned to the right side of the crowd.
"Old Liu. "
Hearing Rhodes' greeting, the tall and thin mage walked out of the crowd and came to his side. Rhodes stared at the mage in front of him, silent for a moment, then reached out and took off the badge on his chest and placed it in his hand.
[System Announcement: The position of guild president is transferred, and the position of group leader is transferred]
“The next era is your era. "
Rhodes let go of his hand, his voice was very calm and did not change at all.
“So, this battle is left to you to command. "
"Okay, no problem, Rod. "
The mage nodded, but soon, he spoke again.
“Then, as the guild president and the team leader, I order you to lead the team. "
"Old Liu? "
Hearing this answer, Rhodes couldn't help but frowned in surprise. But at this time, the tall and thin mage facing him smiled softly, and then patted Rhodes on the shoulder.
"You started this era, it has a beginning and an end, Rhodes, this is the way to be a human being. "
"..."
After hearing these words, Rhodes fell silent. He raised his head and looked at his companions not far in front of him. At this moment, they were ready and waiting for his orders as always. Rhodes clenched his sword tightly, then turned around and faced the high platform not far away, where thunder was raging, roaring and flashing with bright light.
Then, Rhodes raised his sword and pointed forward. He once had the most ordinary beginning, so let's have the most ordinary ending.
"Get weird! ! "
The Dragon of the Void is indeed extremely powerful.
Rhodes has fought against almost all ranked BOSSs in the Dragon Soul Continent, including other dragon souls in the setting, but none of them are more difficult than the Void Dragon in front of him. Its attack pattern is more complicated and almost irregular. Its damage is several times higher than that of ordinary BOSSs. Not to mention that its speed, reaction, and even defense are all at a first-rate level.
This is indeed a difficult opponent to conquer.
Rhodes held the long sword in his hand, clenching his teeth and staring at the behemoth in front of him. The battle had reached the final moment, and he was the only survivor. However, even so, Rhodes's blood volume was exhausted. The dazzling red color reminded him that his vitality had reached the limit.
Isn't this the case with the Dragon of the Void?
Looking at the opponent's blood-red dragon eyes full of anger, Rhodes suddenly had a very strange feeling. He seemed to be able to understand the mood of the Void Dragon - as the most powerful BOSS in the game that has never been conquered by anyone, it must be feeling uncomfortable now that it is about to fall to the ground.
Then, let me go with you.
Thinking of this, Rhodes raised his left hand.
With a crisp cry, streaks of burning flames suddenly erupted from Rhodes' sword. They circled and turned into a flying firebird. They raised their heads to the sky and rushed towards the Void Dragon in front of them. Facing the oncoming attack, the Void Dragon also let out a roar and then raised it high.The front paws suddenly pounced down.
"!!!"
Rhodes felt his body suddenly shake, and the powerful force rushed towards him. The flamingo screamed and was immediately shaken. However, the strong explosion before it disappeared also caused the claws originally swung by the Void Dragon not to be fully effective, but was forcefully shaken away.
For a moment, the door was wide open.
Rhodes gritted his teeth, and the bright red in front of his eyes became more and more dazzling, indicating that the damage he had received had reached the critical point, but now this was no longer within the scope of his consideration. This was the last chance, either success or the group was destroyed. He raised the long sword in his hand and thrust forward, but at this time, the Void Dragon had already slowed down. It roared, and then swung its claws downward again. At the same time, Rhodes also threw the long sword in his hand.
A thunderous strike to activate.
The long sword turned into a dazzling light and shot directly into the dragon's chest. Rhodes watched it intently, watching the light mixed with thunder and lightning emerge from the gap between the Void Dragon's claws, and then easily tore the scales on the dragon's body.
“————!!!”
A deafening dragon roar erupted from the ground, and then, the huge dragon claws slapped Rhodes hard on the body.
The bright red color in front of him almost enveloped the entire world, and Rhodes could no longer see clearly the scene in front of him, but the system prompts emerging from the corner were still as clear as ever.
[Congratulations to the Starlight Guild for winning the first kill of the Void Dragon, an eternal evil has been eliminated]
[The character has received excessive damage and is about to die]
It's finally over.
Looking at this line of system prompts, Rhodes showed a relieved smile.
At this moment, a bright beam of light suddenly fell from the sky and enveloped the high platform.
The pure white light illuminated the originally dark sky at that moment, dispelling the lingering clouds.
But at this moment, the others who were resurrecting from the cemetery and rushing towards the high platform suddenly stopped, and the World Channel, which was originally abuzz because the Starlight Guild once again achieved the first kill record, suddenly became quiet at this moment.
For a time, there was only one piece of information left on it, which was a system announcement.
[System Announcement: Player Rhodes has been offline]
A legend that has dominated three gaming eras has come to an end.
